name: Kan | Open-Source Trello Alternative (Kanban Boards for Teams)
description: Kanban boards, lists and cards for teams, with Trello import
card_desc: Kan: an open-source Trello alternative. Boards, lists, cards with labels, checklists, comments and attachments, workspaces with members, and one-click Trello import. Runs Kan 0.6.0 on Postgres with a Railway bucket for files and invite-only sign-up.
